# mutation-pin: REQ_STRUCTURED_SCHEMA_CONTRACT SM-E58B2C96
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from pydantic import BaseModel, ValidationError

from llm_router._internal.capabilities.schema import normalize_schema

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


class WeatherReport(BaseModel):
    city: str
    temperature_c: int


class StockQuote(BaseModel):
    city: str
    temperature_c: int


@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_STRUCTURED_SCHEMA_CONTRACT[revision==2]")
def test_foreign_model_instance_is_not_returned_as_requested_model() -> None:
    spec = normalize_schema(WeatherReport)
    foreign = StockQuote(city="Oslo", temperature_c=12)

    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match=r"WeatherReport"):
        spec.parse(foreign)


@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_STRUCTURED_SCHEMA_CONTRACT[revision==2]")
def test_requested_model_instance_and_json_reconstruct_requested_type() -> None:
    spec = normalize_schema(WeatherReport)
    report = WeatherReport(city="Oslo", temperature_c=12)

    assert spec.parse(report) is report
    parsed = spec.parse('{"city": "Oslo", "temperature_c": 12}')
    assert type(parsed) is WeatherReport
    assert parsed == report
